## Authorship and responsibility {.unnumbered}

Despite the substantive role of AI in this work, the author retains full
responsibility for all claims, formulations, and conclusions presented
herein. The AI systems are not listed as authors, consistent with
prevailing norms from the International Committee of Medical Journal
Editors (ICMJE) and leading scholarly publishers: they do not meet
authorship criteria concerning accountability, consent, or the capacity
to respond to review.
